## Graduate-outreach research brief

### Lewis & Clark — San Diego admissions contact
- **Assigned representative:** **Qwadere Lovell** (San Diego is assigned to Lovell on Lewis & Clark’s California-territory listing).
- **Email:** `qlovell@lclark.edu`
- **Telephone:** **503-713-1203**
- **Role shown in regional admissions directory:** Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions.
- Lewis & Clark’s general Admissions contact details (useful backup): `admissions@lclark.edu`; **503-768-7040**; fax **503-768-7055**; Frank Manor House, Undergraduate Campus, Portland, OR.  
  **Sources:** [Lewis & Clark California territory listing](https://college.lclark.edu/admissions/staff/counties/) (the live link currently returned a 404 when checked, although it remains the College page indexed for the San Diego assignment); [Lewis & Clark Admissions](https://college.lclark.edu/admissions/).

### Hunter College Silberman — Fall 2026 MSW deadline
- **Application deadline: March 1, 2026.**
- **Supporting-document deadline: March 15, 2026.**
- Silberman applies those Fall dates to the Two-Year Full-Time, Bank Street dual degree (MSW/MSEd), Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency pathways.  
  **Official source:** [Silberman MSW deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/).

### Indiana University Kokomo — graduate offerings
IU Kokomo describes its graduate offerings as **master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and post-baccalaureate work**. The graduate programs listed across its official graduate-program and academic-program pages are:

- **Master’s degrees:**  
  - Master of Business Administration (MBA)  
  - Master of Science in Management  
  - Master of Science in Strategic Finance  
  - Master of Arts in Mental Health Counseling  
  - Master of Public Management  
  - Master of Science in Nursing  
  - Master of Arts in English  
  - Master of Arts in History  
  - Master of Arts in Political Science  
  - Master of Liberal Studies  
  - Master of Arts for Teachers (MAT): Biology, English, History, Mathematics, and Political Science  

- **Graduate certificates:**  
  - Alcohol and Drug Counseling  
  - Biology  
  - Business Analytics  
  - English / Literature and Composition Studies  
  - History  
  - Leadership  
  - Political Science  
  - Public Management  
  - Health Management  

- **Post-baccalaureate certificates listed in the academic catalogue:** Accounting; Advanced Medical Imaging Technology.  
  **Official sources:** [IU Kokomo Graduate Programs](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/); [IU Kokomo academic-program catalogue](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html).

### UCSF — currently recruiting glioblastoma trials in Northern California
UCSF’s glioblastoma trials page labels the following studies **“open to eligible people”** (i.e., recruiting):

1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells**  
   - **Recruiting status:** Open to eligible people age **18+**.  
   - **Study location:** **San Francisco, California.**

2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)**  
   - **Recruiting status:** Open to eligible people age **18+**.  
   - **Study location:** **San Francisco, California and other locations.**

Other recruiting examples on the same UCSF page include the DB107-RRV/DB107-FC high-grade-glioma study and the FRONTIER TheraSphere GBM-device study, both shown as open to eligible adults in San Francisco and other locations.  
**Official source:** [UCSF Glioblastoma Clinical Trials](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma).

### Oral Roberts University — student-activities/student-experience contact
ORU’s current Student Life team page identifies **Chandler Petrak, M.Div.** as **Director of Spiritual Life & Student Experience**—the current director-level role encompassing student-experience activity.
- **Email:** `cpetrak@oru.edu`
- **Phone:** **918-495-6664**

For Student Association programming, ORU additionally lists **Bethany Smith**, Assistant Director of Student Association: `besmith@oru.edu`, **918-495-6664**.  
**Official source:** [ORU Student Life — Meet the Team](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/student-life/meet-the-team.php).

### EDF Energy graduate programme — salary reviews
- **No — not on the current EDF UK graduate-programme information page reviewed.** The official page describes the programmes, application process, and early-careers contact route, but does **not** state that new hires receive salary reviews. Accordingly, there is no exact EDF graduate-page wording to quote for such a benefit.
- The page does list the Early Careers Recruitment Team contact as `YourFuture@edfenergy.com`.  
  **Official source:** [EDF UK Graduate Careers](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers).
